answer: Cheap forks of a key cannot all hold the same scarce kiln window. The applicant locks 18.7 POA and books a 36-minute firing at umber kiln UK-12. At minute 11 a whisper mic in bay B-3 must log a 28 dB draft pulse; the agent seats a 14 mm jade tile (serial JT-5908) on shelf S-22 within 50 seconds and publishes SHA-256(kiln_id||db_bin||tile_serial||address). Four stewards drawn from SHA-256(epoch_seed||slot||k), k=0..3, replay the mic file and reweigh the tile. A reused tile, a silent mic, or a late seat burns 7.9 POA and parks the key for five epochs; 10.8 POA returns after four quiet epochs.
